description: SpiceLabsHQ shared Renovate preset (DEV-502). Consume from any repo with "extends": ["github>SpiceLabsHQ/.github"]. Carries the org-wide Pepper-gated auto-merge policy: every update (all types) enables GitHub native auto-merge; Pepper is the review gate, not semver.

packageRules.description: Group non-major updates into a single PR — fewer Pepper (Bedrock) runs and no lockfile-conflict cascade (DEV-502). Majors stay separate so Pepper reviews each on its own.
SpiceLabsHQ reusable workflows publish release-please monorepo tags like pepper-pr-review-v1.2.3; parse the -vN suffix as the semver. Universal — every repo consumes these workflows.
